combat.modifiedpvp.combo.dual_special: Speed II and Strength II for 90s
combat.modifiedpvp.combo.axe_special: Next heavy attack deals double damage
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.root.des: Unlock a special move for each weapon.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.sword.de: Kill 50 mobs with a sword. A 5-hit combo grants automatic critical hits for 15 seconds. Damage interrupts it. 60 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.dual.des: Kill 50 mobs while dual wielding swords. A 7-hit combo grants Speed II and Strength II for 90 seconds. Damage interrupts it. 120 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.axe.desc: Land 20 heavy attacks. A 3-hit combo empowers the next heavy attack with double damage and a 3 second stun. You take no damage between those hits. 50 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.bow.desc: Hit 10 different mobs with a bow. A 7-hit combo removes the draw time for 10 seconds. Damage interrupts it. 30 second cooldown.
Pull a drowned with a trident. A 5-pull combo inflicts Slowness III on the last target for 20 seconds. You take no damage between pulls. 60 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.shield.d: Block 30 hits with a shield. A 3-block combo makes the next block return half the damage and launch the attacker upward. Damage that gets through interrupts it. 45 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.mace.des: Land 10 chain throws. A 3-hit combo, from a smash or the chain, makes the next hit pull targets in and inflict Slowness II for 4 seconds. You take no damage between those hits. 70 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.spear.de: Land 10 perfect Counter Strikes against hostile mobs. Build Pressure until Broken Defense, then choose Total Reaction (Z) or Circular Collapse (jab). Counter Strike and Pressure work before the unlock.
